task.question: Do E025 independent-signal candidates improve same-target walk-forward outcomes over B and uniform random tickets?
task.novelty: Frozen top-six predictors evaluated over 645 expanding-information targets with 100 same-target random tickets per target, B component comparators, block uncertainty, and Holm correction.

spec.research_question: Do E025 independent-signal candidates improve same-target walk-forward outcomes over B and uniform random tickets?
spec.training_cutoff_rule: Each signal prediction for target t is generated from rounds 1..t-1; no tuning is performed on target outcomes.
spec.primary_metric: mean hits and rate_ge_3 versus same-target random tickets
spec.comparator: same-target seven frozen B components and combined_equal_rank
spec.baseline: 100 independently sampled uniform six-number tickets per target round
spec.multiplicity_correction: Holm step-down over 3 candidate signals x 5 registered random-comparison metrics.
spec.tie_break: descending frozen signal score, then lower number
spec.novelty_signature: E025 fixed independent formulas; 601..1245; same-target 100-ticket random simulation; B component comparisons; circular moving-block paired CI; Holm15
